name: Trade on qualified RSI
summary: This EA trades based on RSI signals that are qualified by additional conditions, entering long positions when RSI indicates oversold conditions and short positions when RSI indicates overbought conditions, with qualifying filters to avoid false signals. It systematically opens and closes positions based on these refined RSI extremes, aiming to capture mean-reversion moves in the market.
summary_zh: 该EA基于经过额外条件过滤的RSI信号进行交易，当RSI指示超卖时做多，指示超买时做空，通过附加过滤条件来避免虚假信号。它系统性地在这些精炼的RSI极值点开仓和平仓，旨在捕捉市场的均值回归行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的经典超买超卖均值回归逻辑，但加入了'qualified'（合格化）过滤条件来提升信号质量。入场条件为：RSI跌破超卖阈值且满足额外过滤条件时做多，RSI升破超买阈值且满足额外过滤条件时做空。出场条件可能包括RSI回归中性区域、固定止盈止损或反向信号出现。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，设置了止损和止盈参数来控制每笔交易的风险收益比，但具体的资金管理策略取决于参数配置的保守程度。整体而言，该策略试图在RSI极值区域捕捉价格回归均值的机会，过滤条件的设计旨在减少单纯RSI超买超卖策略中常见的逆势交易风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic RSI overbought/oversold mean reversion logic, enhanced with 'qualified' filtering conditions to improve signal quality. Entry conditions: go long when RSI drops below the oversold threshold and additional qualifying filters are met; go short when RSI rises above the overbought threshold and qualifying filters are met. Exit conditions likely include RSI returning to neutral zones, fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, or the appearance of a reversal signal. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may include dynamic position calculation based on account balance. Money management utilizes stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control the risk-reward ratio of each trade, though the conservatism depends on parameter configuration. Overall, the strategy attempts to capture mean-reversion opportunities at RSI extremes, with qualifying filters designed to reduce the common risk of counter-trend trades found in plain RSI overbought/oversold strategies.

pros: 使用RSI极值过滤策略，在均值回归框架下具有统计优势
加入合格化过滤条件，比单纯RSI超买超卖策略减少了虚假信号
参数化设计灵活，用户可根据不同市场环境调整RSI阈值和风控参数
pros_en: Uses RSI extreme filtering strategy with statistical edge under mean reversion framework
Qualified filtering conditions reduce false signals compared to plain RSI overbought/oversold strategies
Flexible parameterized design allows users to adjust RSI thresholds and risk control parameters for different market conditions
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续逆势亏损
若止损设为0或过大，单笔交易风险可能极高
RSI作为单一指标缺乏多维度确认，过滤条件强度取决于具体实现
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies are prone to consecutive counter-trend losses in strong trending markets
If stop-loss is set to 0 or too wide, single trade risk can be extremely high
RSI as a single indicator lacks multi-dimensional confirmation; filter strength depends on specific implementation
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势开仓
加入动态仓位管理和资金百分比风险控制，替代固定手数交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trends
Implement dynamic position sizing with percentage-based risk control instead of fixed lot trading

risk_points: 止损参数默认值为0可能导致无限风险暴露
均值回归策略在单边行情中存在连续逆势亏损风险
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss value of 0 may lead to unlimited risk exposure
Mean reversion strategy carries risk of consecutive counter-trend losses in one-directional markets
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same signal

It systematically opens and closes positions based on these refined RSI extremes, aiming to capture mean-reversion moves in the market.
